HelpSection.zh: 如何让我的伙伴帮我？ 标记卡牌以分配特定任务，或将卡片放入伙伴的物品栏，他们就会去做。必要情况下，确保他们有合适的工具。 为什么我的伙伴不做任务？ 很可能是因为他们感到不满（在详情标签页中可见）。如果你发现他们不满，请暂时停止分配任务，直到他们心情好转。 为什么我的伙伴总是心怀不满？ 根据他们的性格以及对你的信任程度，当你请求帮助时，伙伴更容易产生不满。如果你善待他们，他们的信任和好感度会增加，他们也会逐渐变得更加乐于助人。 为什么我的伙伴想要得到关注或感到被忽视？ 可能是因为你很久没有和他们交流了。试着时不时地和他们聊聊天，让他们开心。 “随意交谈”通常是最简单的选择。 如何确保我的伴侣对我所说的话做出积极回应？ 确认你的伴侣没有感觉到尴尬，不然就等到不再尴尬的时候。只有在你的注意力较高时才使用“倾听”。
HelpSection.en: How can I get my partner to help me? Mark cards for specific duties or place them in your partner's inventory and they will work on them. Make sure they have the appropriate tools if necessary. Why is my partner not doing his duties? Most likely because they're feeling resentful (visible in the details tab). If you see them resentful stop assigning duties for a while until they feel better. Why is my partner always resentful? Depending on their personality and how much they trust you, partners will get resentful faster when you ask for help. If you treat them well, their trust and affection will increase and they will gradually become more helpful. Why does my partner want attention or feel neglected? Probably because you haven't talked to them in a while. Try talking to them every now and then to keep them happy. "Casual talk" is usually the easiest option. How can I ensure my partner reacts positvely to what I say? Make sure your partner is not feeling akward and otherwise wait until that's no longer the case. Use "listen" only if your focus is high.
